podcast.title: Early Life and Education
podcast.body: William Butler, Win Butler's younger brother by two years, shared the same upbringing, moving with his family to The Woodlands near Houston in 1984. He attended prep school in Boston alongside his brother, where he was exposed to influential post-punk and alternative bands. "William Butler, Wins younger brother by two years, had the same upbringing."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Joining Arcade Fire
podcast.body: William Butler was "drafted" into Arcade Fire following an onstage implosion during a debut EP performance, joining a new lineup that also included Tim Kingsbury and Richard Reed Perry. "But then, baby brother William Butler was drafted along with Tim Kingsbury of Guelph Ontario"

podcast.title: University Studies
podcast.body: After prep school in Boston, William Butler pursued higher education at Northwestern University in Chicago, where he majored in poetry and Slavic studies. "From there, William went to Northwestern University in Chicago where he majored in poetry and Slavic studies."

xref.title: Boston Prep School Exposure
xref.body: Both Win and his younger brother, William Butler, attended prep school in Boston, where they were exposed to influential bands like Joy Division, New Order, James, The Cure, Echo and the Bunnymen, and The Smiths, shaping their early musical tastes. "And this is where they were exposed to music from. Joy Division, New Order, James the Cure, Echo and the Bunnieman and the Smiths."
